title: Hands-free trunk and driving features
summary: This topic mixes hands-free trunk access and hands-free driving comments, with many fragments describing operation or setup rather than a clear evaluation.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise liking the hands-free feature and missing a previously owned hands-free trunk feature.

negative.summary: Negative feedback reports the hands-free driving feature being unavailable during another vehicle issue.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews describe intermittent trunk operation, setup checks, resumed operation, and descriptive hands-free driving behavior without a clearly assigned evaluation.

limitations: The cluster mixes unrelated subjects, including hands-free trunk access, hands-free driving, and one fragment about hands slipping on the wheel.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so clear sentiment examples are limited.
